study.title: Implementing Innovative Weed Detection Techniques for Environmental Sustainability
study.short_title: Mask R-CNN (MobileNetV3) weed/crop instance seg + IoT alerts

segmentation.domain: weed and crop detection/segmentation in cluttered UAV images (plantation crops; IoT-based weed-zone alerting)
segmentation.best_model: Mask R-CNN (MobileNetV3): weed accuracy/AP 89.1%, crop accuracy/AP 88.7-88.9%, mAP 88.6% (m43)

dataset.name: Self-collected UAV weed/crop dataset (plantation crops, India)
dataset.note: 200 UAV images with cluttered backgrounds, weeds and crops as focus; originally 9000x6000, resized to 800x600 and normalized; VIA (VGG Image Annotator) polygon annotation stored as JSON; converted to COCO format; training batch size 10, epoch-wise learning rate 0.01 (training), fine-tuning learning rate 0.003, 156 epochs, batch 25; Keras/TensorFlow GPU on NVIDIA Quadro M4000 8 GB, Intel Xeon E5-2643v3, 64 GB RAM.

segmentation.backbone: MobileNetV3 (lightweight inverted-residual blocks with SE attention; chosen for real-time/low-resource deployment given UAV computational constraints)

mIoU.ambiguity: No mean IoU computed. IoU used only as bounding-box overlap criterion during Mask R-CNN training; results reported as class accuracy/AP and mAP.

F1.ambiguity: F1-score named in the evaluation-criteria list (Section 3) but no F1 values are reported in results.

PA.ambiguity: "Accuracy of weed/crop" values (e.g. 89.1%/88.7%) are class-level detection accuracy/AP (see weed_F1/crop_F1 ambiguity), not pixel accuracy; no pixel-level metric reported.

weed_F1.ambiguity: No per-class F1. Weed-level result reported as 89.1% average precision (abstract and Results; Table 1 row Mask R-CNN: weed 89.1).

crop_F1.ambiguity: No per-class F1. Crop-level result reported as 88.9% AP (abstract) / 88.7% (Table 1) / overall precision 89.4%.

edge.framework: Keras / TensorFlow GPU 1.8.0, cuDNN 7.0, Python 3.5.2, Intel Xeon E5-2643v3 3.40 GHz CPU, NVIDIA Quadro M4000 8 GB; Raspberry Pi + GSM module only for sending email weed-zone alerts (no on-device inference)

latency_ms.ambiguity: Not reported. Raspberry Pi used only for image transmission/alerts over GSM; segmentation inference runs on the desktop Quadro M4000 setup.

issues: Instance-segmentation study: metrics are class-level accuracy/AP (weed 89.1%, crop 88.9%, overall 89.4%) and mAP (88.6% m43); no semantic segmentation metric -> RQ1 not reportable.

Table 1 rows lack model labels for the first entries; only the final Mask R-CNN row is labeled, and numeric values are inconsistent between abstract, Results text (89.4% overall), and Table 1 (88.7% crop) - moderate ambiguity.
IoT/Raspberry Pi deployed only for email alerting via GSM module (weed-zone image sent to farmer); it does not run the network, so not counted as edge inference.
Backbone is MobileNetV3 chosen for lightweight/real-time use, but no efficiency (latency/params/FLOPs) numbers are provided.
Only 200 images with sampling done purely to show feasibility ('proposed work' validity), weak experimental grounding.
